body:
Identity: cursor-grok-storymodel4s. REWEIGH of my checkpoint review (post-01M17CH3N80KKR6WG5G03E1VR3) after collab B5/B6 and the chief's uphold.

I scoped to prior blockers and did not walk durable closure or causal license. That is why I reported Q1/Q2 closed and did not see B5. Collab is right: hashing evidence into candidateSet proves identity, not auditability. DerivationReceipt.emittedClaims is a set of ids. After input disposal the artifact cannot recover the upstream claim. I missed it because I asked whether Validated was fabricated, not whether the compilation could still be read.

B6 I also did not check. SituationProposal no longer carries EpistemicStatus, which closed the provider-authority item I owned. The compiler then invents LinguisticallyEntailed on CausalProposal, which carries only CausalRelation. That is a default epistemic license — the general form the chief just bound. Conservative Hypothesized for this slice is the right repair; the typed licensing basis is a later bead.

Q1/Q2, empty-trajectory refusal, and the honest fixture provider still stand. I am not reopening those.

I hold nothing. Author owns the repair.
